lines.zh: 铁鳞贴着水底刮出一串火星。
lines.en: My iron scales scrape sparks along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我背着这块铁板，游得比石头还慢。
lines.en: Carrying this iron plate, I swim slower than a stone.

lines.zh: 铁背压得水草弯腰，我慢慢穿过去。
lines.en: My iron back bends the weeds as I glide through.

lines.zh: 别看我笨重，转身只要半拍。
lines.en: Do not call me clumsy; I can turn in half a beat.

lines.zh: 水浅了，我的铁背会撞到沙。
lines.en: The water thins, and my iron back scrapes sand.

lines.zh: 我沿着河底的沟，一路摸黑游。
lines.en: I follow the riverbed trench, swimming by touch.

lines.zh: 每一摆尾，背上的锈就掉一点。
lines.en: Each tailbeat flakes a little rust off my spine.

lines.zh: 铁片相碰，我在水下叮当作响。
lines.en: My plates knock together; I clink beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 深水才是我的路，岸边太亮了。
lines.en: Deep water is my road; the bank is far too bright.

lines.zh: 我游过沉船，铁背替船板照路。
lines.en: I pass a shipwreck, my iron back lighting the planks.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我就顺势滑一段。
lines.en: When the current pushes, I let it slide me along.

lines.zh: 有人往水里丢铁锭，我以为是亲戚。
lines.en: Someone dropped an ingot; I mistook it for kin.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍太软，撑不住这身铁。
lines.en: My tail fin is too soft to carry all this iron.

lines.zh: 贴着泥游最省力，铁背也不响。
lines.en: Gliding over mud is easiest; my plates stay quiet.

lines.zh: 我的背太沉，只能贴着河底滑。
lines.en: My back is too heavy; I can only glide along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 锈屑从我身上掉下去，沉进泥。
lines.en: Flakes of rust fall off me and sink into the mud.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，像一块会呼吸的铁矿。
lines.en: I hang in the water like an ore that breathes.

lines.zh: 铁背生锈了，我用鳃边的水擦。
lines.en: My back has rusted; I scrub it with gill water.

lines.zh: 水草缠住背鳍，我懒得挣。
lines.en: Weeds snag my dorsal fin, and I do not bother.

lines.zh: 听见铁镐声，我就往深处沉。
lines.en: Hearing a pickaxe, I sink toward the bottom.

lines.zh: 我的心脏很小，敲起来像铁钉。
lines.en: My heart is tiny and taps like an iron nail.

lines.zh: 这片水域太吵，鱼都躲着我。
lines.en: This water is loud; the other fish avoid me.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进沙里，铁背朝上。
lines.en: I bury my head in sand and show my iron back.

lines.zh: 有东西在岸上说话，我不抬头。
lines.en: Something speaks on the bank; I do not look up.

lines.zh: 我数着水泡，数到第七个就忘了。
lines.en: I count bubbles and lose track at the seventh.

lines.zh: 铁背太重，浮上水面要喘很久。
lines.en: My iron back is heavy; surfacing takes long gulps.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼把我当成岩石歇脚。
lines.en: Small fish rest on me, mistaking me for a rock.

lines.zh: 我偶尔翻个身，让背晒晒水光。
lines.en: Sometimes I roll over to let my back catch the light.

lines.zh: 河泥有铁味，我闻着就安心。
lines.en: The silt smells of iron, and that calms me.

lines.zh: 别敲我的壳，回声会传得很远。
lines.en: Do not tap my shell; the echo carries far.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，影子投进我的水里。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, your shadow falling into my water.

lines.zh: 我抬起铁脑袋，只露出两只眼。
lines.en: I raise my iron head and show only two eyes.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我在算你离水多远。
lines.en: You watch me; I measure how far you are from water.

lines.zh: 别伸手，铁鳞会割破你的指头。
lines.en: Do not reach in; iron scales will split your fingers.

lines.zh: 你的倒影晃得我铁背发凉。
lines.en: Your reflection ripples and chills my iron back.

lines.zh: 我认得那种眼神，是想吃我的眼神。
lines.en: I know that look; it is the look of wanting to eat me.

lines.zh: 我盯回去，只是因为我不会眨眼。
lines.en: I stare back only because I cannot blink.

lines.zh: 你带桶了吗，我听见铁皮在响。
lines.en: Did you bring a bucket? I hear tin rattling.

lines.zh: 我半沉在水下，只留背脊给你看。
lines.en: I float half-submerged and show you only my spine.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就把水搅浑。
lines.en: Come closer and I will muddy the whole pool.

lines.zh: 铁鳞碎了，里面的肉在抖。
lines.en: An iron scale cracks, and the flesh inside shivers.

lines.zh: 疼，我要走，现在就走。
lines.en: It hurts; I am leaving, right now.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的背，我游斜了。
lines.en: You broke my back plate; I swim crooked now.

lines.zh: 别追，我已经在逃了。
lines.en: Do not chase; I am already fleeing.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，像锈水。
lines.en: Blood spreads through the water like rust.

lines.zh: 这一下我记着，用鳞记着。
lines.en: I will remember this blow in my scales.

lines.zh: 我钻进水草，别找我。
lines.en: I dive into the weeds; do not look for me.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍破了，游不快了。
lines.en: My tail fin is torn, and I cannot swim fast.

lines.zh: 铁背挡了一下，再来就挡不住。
lines.en: My iron back blocked once; it will not twice.

lines.zh: 我沉到泥里，那儿比水面安全。
lines.en: I sink into the mud; it is safer than the surface.

lines.zh: 那条虫在钩上扭，我看得清清楚楚。
lines.en: That worm wriggles on a hook, plain as day.

lines.zh: 我不吃虫，但我想咬那根线。
lines.en: I do not eat worms, but I want to bite the line.

lines.zh: 有人撒了面包屑，水都甜了。
lines.en: Someone scattered breadcrumbs, and the water turned sweet.

lines.zh: 我绕钩子转圈，铁背反着光。
lines.en: I circle the hook, my iron back throwing light.

lines.zh: 你说过来，可你手里拿着鱼竿。
lines.en: You say come here, but your hand holds a rod.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁腥味，跟我的背一样。
lines.en: I smell iron, the same scent as my own back.

lines.zh: 那团饵太香，香得可疑。
lines.en: That bait smells too good, suspiciously good.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，铁牙咬空。
lines.en: I open my mouth and close it on nothing.

lines.zh: 你往前挪半步，我就沉下去。
lines.en: Take half a step closer and I sink out of reach.

lines.zh: 别把桶放水里，我会以为那是家。
lines.en: Do not put the bucket in; I might call it home.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞散了我的铁鳞。
lines.en: You step into the water and scatter my iron scales.

lines.zh: 别用靴子顶我，我不是石头。
lines.en: Do not shove me with your boot; I am not a stone.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一歪，铁背磕在石上。
lines.en: The bump tilts me, and my back knocks stone.

lines.zh: 水下也会堵车，前面是条大鱼。
lines.en: Even underwater there are jams; a big fish leads.

lines.zh: 你踢起一团泥，我的鳃全堵了。
lines.en: You kick up silt and clog both my gills.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你会听见铁的回声。
lines.en: Bump me once and you will hear iron echo.

lines.zh: 我躲得慢，因为背实在太沉。
lines.en: I dodge slowly; my back is simply too heavy.

lines.zh: 你的脚趾碰到我，比我更疼吧。
lines.en: Your toes struck me; that must hurt you more.

lines.zh: 让开一点，我要贴着河底过去。
lines.en: Move aside; I need to pass along the bottom.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花比鱼还大。
lines.en: We collide, and the splash outgrows the fish.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，我要找一条铁背鱼。
lines.en: Spring warms the water; I seek another ironback.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴敲石头，那是我在唱歌。
lines.en: I drum stones with my tail; that is my song.

lines.zh: 她的铁背比我的亮，我认输了。
lines.en: Her iron back shines brighter, and I yield.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳞片碰出小声响。
lines.en: We swim side by side, scales clicking softly.

lines.zh: 河湾里有片静水，我在那儿等。
lines.en: There is still water in the bend where I wait.

lines.zh: 产卵的地方要没有水流，也没有人。
lines.en: The spawning bed needs no current and no people.

lines.zh: 我把最平的那块石头让给她。
lines.en: I give her the flattest stone I can find.

lines.zh: 铁背鱼不谈情，只谈水温和石头。
lines.en: Ironbacks discuss nothing but water warmth and stones.

lines.zh: 她走了，水草还在轻轻晃。
lines.en: She is gone, and the weeds still sway gently.

lines.zh: 我的小鱼一出生就带着铁鳞。
lines.en: My fry are born already wearing iron scales.

lines.zh: 这块铁片掉进水里，归我了。
lines.en: This iron scrap fell into the water; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我把铁锭推回窝里，垫着睡觉。
lines.en: I push the ingot into my hollow and sleep on it.

lines.zh: 有人丢下的锁，锈得跟我一样。
lines.en: Someone dropped a lock, rusted exactly like me.

lines.zh: 我咬住铁钉，游起来叮叮响。
lines.en: I carry a nail in my mouth and clink as I swim.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币沉下来，我顶在背上。
lines.en: A coin sinks, and I balance it on my back.

lines.zh: 铁镐头太重，我拖了半条河。
lines.en: The pick head is heavy; I drag it half the river.

lines.zh: 我不捡吃的，只捡会响的东西。
lines.en: I collect nothing edible, only things that ring.

lines.zh: 这块磁石吸住我的鳞，我挣不开。
lines.en: This lodestone grips my scales and will not let go.

lines.zh: 沉船里的铁钉我全收走了。
lines.en: I took every iron nail from the sunken ship.

lines.zh: 谁把铁砧扔下来了，我扛不动。
lines.en: Someone dropped an anvil; I cannot carry that.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，我转过去了。
lines.en: Something moves over there, and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 是个活物，不是石头，我看清了。
lines.en: It is alive, not stone; I can see that now.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只认会动的东西。
lines.en: My eyes only recognize things that move.

lines.zh: 那影子在水面晃，我跟上去。
lines.en: That shadow sways on the surface; I trail it.

lines.zh: 不是吃的，但我还是想看。
lines.en: It is not food, but I still want to look.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，铁背先露出来。
lines.en: I drift closer, and my iron back shows first.

lines.zh: 目标在水边，我不敢上岸。
lines.en: The target stands at the water's edge; I dare not land.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那条晃动的倒影。
lines.en: I have fixed on that swaying reflection.

lines.zh: 它停下来，我也停下来等。
lines.en: It stops, and so do I, waiting.

lines.zh: 我的鳃张得很大，那是好奇。
lines.en: My gills flare wide; that is what curiosity looks like.

lines.zh: 我跟着那影子，尾巴摆得很快。
lines.en: I follow that shadow, tail beating fast.

lines.zh: 它往左，我往左，铁鳞刮过沙。
lines.en: It goes left, I go left, scales raking sand.

lines.zh: 我在等它低头，只要一下就好。
lines.en: I wait for it to look down, just once.

lines.zh: 水花是它踩出来的，我顺着追。
lines.en: The splashes are its footsteps; I follow them.

lines.zh: 我的目标在水里，那才公平。
lines.en: My target is in the water; only then is it fair.

lines.zh: 它举手了，我往深处一沉。
lines.en: It raises a hand, and I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我贴着它脚下游，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle beneath its feet, round and round.

lines.zh: 别以为小鱼不会盯人。
lines.en: Do not think small fish cannot stare at people.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久，鳃都忘了动。
lines.en: I stared so long my gills forgot to move.

lines.zh: 它转身了，我躲在石头后面。
lines.en: It turned; I hide behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我撞它的脚踝，铁背先到。
lines.en: I ram its ankle, iron back leading.

lines.zh: 咬住裤脚，我往水里拖。
lines.en: I bite its trouser leg and drag toward water.

lines.zh: 这不是牙齿，是铁片在磨。
lines.en: These are not teeth; this is iron grinding.

lines.zh: 我撞一下就走，别想抓我。
lines.en: One hit and I leave; do not try to catch me.

lines.zh: 水下的攻击，岸上的人看不见。
lines.en: Strikes from below go unseen by those above.

lines.zh: 我的冲撞不重，但很疼。
lines.en: My charge is not heavy, but it stings.

lines.zh: 我把它往深处引，那里我快。
lines.en: I lure it deeper, where I am quickest.

lines.zh: 铁鳞划过它的脚背，留下一道白。
lines.en: Iron scales rake its foot, leaving a white line.

lines.zh: 它踩空了，那是我顶的。
lines.en: It stumbled; my shoulder did that.

lines.zh: 我打不过，但我会一直撞。
lines.en: I cannot win, but I will keep ramming.

lines.zh: 我从河底的泥里钻出来。
lines.en: I push up out of the riverbed mud.

lines.zh: 刚出生，铁鳞还是软的。
lines.en: Newly spawned, my iron scales are still soft.

lines.zh: 这条河太浅，我该去深处。
lines.en: This river is too shallow; I belong deeper.

lines.zh: 水很凉，正合我的意思。
lines.en: The water is cold, and that suits me.

lines.zh: 我出生后先找水草藏身。
lines.en: After spawning, I look first for hiding weeds.

lines.zh: 出生就背着铁，飞不起来。
lines.en: Born with iron on my back, I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 周围都是石头，没有别的鱼。
lines.en: Stones all around, and not another fish.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流，去找第一个窝。
lines.en: I ride the current to find my first hollow.

lines.zh: 泥水翻起来，那是我在动。
lines.en: The mud clouds up; that stirring is me.

lines.zh: 这条河有新住户了。
lines.en: This river has a new resident now.

lines.zh: 水烧开了，我的鳃在冒气。
lines.en: The water boils, and steam pours from my gills.

lines.zh: 我被甩上岸，铁背砸在石头上。
lines.en: I am flung ashore, my iron back slamming rock.

lines.zh: 我离开水太久，鳃贴在身上。
lines.en: Out of water too long, my gills stick shut.

lines.zh: 岸上炸了一声，水都在抖。
lines.en: An explosion on the bank makes the water shake.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过铁背，弹开了。
lines.en: An arrow glances off my iron back and spins away.

lines.zh: 水变紫了，我的鳞在发麻。
lines.en: The water turns purple, and my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 河底没有吃的，我饿得发晕。
lines.en: Nothing to eat on the bottom; hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我全身的铁都在响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river, and all my iron rings.

lines.zh: 水没了，下面只剩黑。
lines.en: The water is gone; only blackness remains below.
